eventDescription:
At the tree plantation event held at the Indian Navy?s Kalpakkam training base, the Chief of the Indian Navy, Vice Admiral A.Y. Sardesai, AVSM, VSM, graced the occasion by planting a palm sapling, the state tree of Tamil Nadu. 
The contribution of the Vidhaigal Organization in collaborating with the Indian Navy for environmental protection and green development is truly commendable.
